name: plan-b-wave3-local-package
description: The local reviewable package of Plan B for the Wave 3 showcase: setup and run instructions, the app source with its public fixtures, the built browser bundle, sanitized recorded traces for the stage fallback, the frozen manifests, the held-out results with their figure and failure analysis, the seven-minute script, the submission deck, poster and documentation, the claims ledger, the rehearsal record and the source and license notes. Built by apps/plan_b/scripts/build_release.py from this explicit allowlist. A local package only: nothing is hosted or submitted.
paths_are: relative to the repository root; the package keeps the same relative layout, so links between packaged files still resolve inside it. Links to planning documents and Wave 2 screenshots outside the allowlist point to the repository

include.role: app source (server, policies, planner, store, public fixtures, frozen manifests)
web source and its boundary check
built browser bundle (scanned for evaluator-only content)
runtime contract, evaluation protocol notes and release checks
held-out results: public records, sanitized traces, reports, figure
sanitized recorded traces for the stage fallback (development runs)
Wave 2 runbook the showcase builds on
protocol, presentation plan, pantry showcase, templates
Wave 3 packet: script, claims ledger, rehearsal record, checklist, evidence
submission: slide deck, poster, Word documentation and their spoken scripts

exclude.why: local secret store and endpoint settings
local state: databases, sessions, join codes, the spend ledger, demo state
evaluator-only held-out cases (messages, timings, predicates, expectations)
evaluator records with predicates and expected outcomes
participant data: none is collected; any participant file is refused

browser_bundle.must_not_contain: any held-out case ref (heldout.json case_refs), any held-out scenario id, or any evaluator case id paired with a ref

public_identifiers.why: the repository's own public URL and the presenter's name appear on purpose in the submission items and the checklist; the identifier scan blanks exactly these strings before searching for local user or host names

verify: every required path is present; no packaged path matches an exclude pattern

no credential-shaped text (an OpenRouter or other sk- key, a bearer token, a private key block or a secret assignment), no local absolute path and no local user or host name in any text file, gzip trace, docx part or PDF (visible text, Info dictionary and inflated streams)
the browser bundle holds no held-out case ref or scenario id
plan_b imported from the package (not the repository): plan-b eval verify-freeze passes
demo_prep.py run from the package prepares a clean state and verifies the packaged traces
plan-b serve from the package starts on 127.0.0.1, serves the board (index.html) and lists the packaged replays; each replay is served byte for byte and verify-trace passes on it
